men.name: Quiet Sharp
men.one_line: Tailored and calm. You look put together without trying to be seen.
avoid_list: Swap boxy, off-the-rack suits for one tailored fit
Swap shiny fabrics for matte wool and cotton
men.famous_for: You carry structure well; collars, clean lines and one strong colour do the work.

men.name: Easy Classic
men.one_line: Relaxed basics that never look dated. Comfortable, and still neat.
signature_pieces: A white Oxford shirt worn untucked
avoid_list: Swap logo-heavy tees for plain, heavier cotton
Swap baggy-everywhere fits for one relaxed piece and one fitted piece
men.famous_for: You look at home in simple things; one good shirt and a good pair of jeans say enough.

men.name: Clean Minimal
men.one_line: Few colours, clean lines, no noise. Everything goes with everything.
avoid_list: Swap busy prints for texture and fit
Swap thin, see-through tees for heavier fabric that drapes
men.famous_for: You wear simple well; clean lines and a tight palette make you look sure of yourself.

men.name: Bold Signal
men.one_line: One loud piece, worn with confidence. People remember what you wore.
signature_pieces: A statement shirt or jacket in one strong colour
Contrasting trousers in a quiet neutral
A confident accessory such as a watch or chain
avoid_list: Swap three loud pieces for one loud piece and two quiet ones
Swap trend prints for a strong solid colour in your season
men.famous_for: You carry colour well; one strong piece with quiet pieces around it is your formula.

men.name: Soft Modern
men.one_line: Soft fabrics, gentle colours and a modern cut. Calm, current and kind.
avoid_list: Swap stiff, heavy fabrics for soft drape and fine knits
Swap harsh black for soft navy, grey or olive
men.famous_for: You wear softness well; gentle fabrics and a modern cut suit your frame.

men.name: Rugged Simple
men.one_line: Texture, sturdy fabrics and outdoor ease. Built to be lived in.
avoid_list: Swap thin, flimsy fabrics for denim, canvas and heavy cotton
Swap distressed-for-effect jeans for clean, dark, hard-wearing denim
men.famous_for: You carry texture well; sturdy fabrics and earthy colours look right on you.

men.name: Polished Heritage
men.one_line: Traditional pieces, worn with care. Roots on show, finish sharp.
signature_pieces: A well-fitted bandhgala or nehru jacket
A fine cotton or linen kurta
avoid_list: Swap ill-fitting festive wear for one tailored traditional piece
Swap shiny polyester kurtas for cotton, linen or raw silk
men.famous_for: You carry tradition well; good fabric, a clean fit and one rich colour do the work.

men.name: Street Clean
men.one_line: Streetwear with a tidy finish. Current, confident and well kept.
signature_pieces: A boxy graphic tee or hoodie in good fabric
avoid_list: Swap worn-out sneakers for one clean pair
Swap many logos for one strong graphic and plain pieces around it
men.famous_for: You wear volume well; relaxed shapes and fresh sneakers give you an easy edge.

women.name: Polished Ease
women.one_line: Neat and comfortable together. You look finished and still relaxed.
signature_pieces: A fluid shirt or kurta in a good fabric
avoid_list: Swap stiff, clingy fabrics for fluid drape
Swap busy accessories for one good bag and one good pair of earrings
women.famous_for: You carry fluid structure well; clean lines and soft drape make you look pulled together.

women.name: Soft Romantic
women.one_line: Flowing shapes, gentle colour and delicate detail. Feminine and light.
signature_pieces: A flowy midi dress or anarkali
A soft embroidered or chikankari top
Delicate jewellery and a light dupatta
avoid_list: Swap heavy synthetic fabrics for mulmul, chiffon and fine cotton
Swap too many frills for one delicate detail
women.famous_for: You carry softness well; flowing shapes and gentle colour suit your features.

women.name: Bold Line
women.one_line: Strong shapes and clear lines. A confident silhouette, with colour to match.
signature_pieces: A structured jacket or sharp-shoulder kurta
High-waist trousers or a clean-cut skirt
One strong colour, head to toe
avoid_list: Swap shapeless layers for one sharp line
Swap several clashing colours for one strong block of colour
women.famous_for: You carry strong lines well; a clean silhouette and one bold colour look made for you.

women.name: Classic Warm
women.one_line: Timeless pieces in warm, friendly colours. Elegant and easy to be around.
signature_pieces: A well-cut silk or cotton saree or kurta set
A tailored cotton shirt in a warm neutral
avoid_list: Swap fast-fashion trend pieces for one timeless staple
Swap cool, stark colours for warm neutrals that glow near your face
women.famous_for: You carry warm colour well; timeless cuts and golden tones look natural on you.

women.name: Relaxed Modern
women.one_line: Easy shapes with a current edge. Comfortable, and clearly chosen.
signature_pieces: Clean white sneakers or flat sandals
avoid_list: Swap shapeless everything for one oversized piece with one fitted piece
Swap faded basics for fresh, well-dyed cotton
women.famous_for: You carry easy shapes well; one relaxed piece and one fitted piece balance you perfectly.

women.name: Sharp Minimal
women.one_line: Tight palette, precise cut, nothing extra. Quiet and exact.
signature_pieces: A structured tote and simple studs
avoid_list: Swap fussy detail for fabric and fit
Swap many neutrals for a tight palette of two or three
women.famous_for: You carry precision well; clean lines and a tight palette make you look sure.

women.name: Festive Maximal
women.one_line: Rich colour, embroidery and shine. You enjoy dressing up, and it shows.
signature_pieces: A richly embroidered lehenga or saree
Statement earrings or a layered necklace
avoid_list: Swap piling on every sparkle for one hero piece of jewellery
Swap shiny, scratchy fabric for silk, georgette or velvet
women.famous_for: You carry rich colour well; embroidery, jewel tones and one hero accessory suit you.

women.name: Quiet Luxe
women.one_line: Expensive-looking, never loud. Great fabric, calm colour, careful fit.
signature_pieces: A fine linen or silk co-ord in one soft colour
A structured leather bag in a neutral
avoid_list: Swap visible logos for fabric quality
Swap many mid-quality pieces for one great piece
women.famous_for: You carry calm colour well; good fabric and tonal dressing do the talking.
